deviations.what: onSuggest builds a StartsWith filter on Name from the typed term (or an empty filter list) and applies it to the suggestionItems BINDING. Reproduced 1:1 through follow_up_action binding_call on that aggregation, so the model stays untouched (app 022 precedent). The suggest event round-trips per keystroke, which is what the sample is about; abap2UI5 serializes round-trips, so an event fired while one is in flight is dropped and the list catches up when typing pauses.
The suggest wire and its binding_call filter are unverified in a running system.
